sloka: ममापि दयितो रामो जीवितादपि लक्ष्मण ।न चाहमेवं शोचामि मैवं त्वं बालिशो भव ।। ७.४६.२८ ॥
transliteration: mamāpi dayito rāmo jīvitādapi lakṣmaṇa ।na cāhamevaṁ śocāmi maivaṁ tvaṁ bāliśo bhava ।। 7.46.28 ॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, Rama is dearer to me even than my own life, yet I do not grieve in this manner, so do not be childish.
